title: Hens Under the Hill
summary: Hedda has lost four hens since the thaw, and it wasn't a fox. Old Skarn and his goblins came down out of the hills with a cartful of the Vale's poultry, and they're selling it to the Redhand in Wickham Keep's bailey. Tell their chief.

steps.journal: Go to Wickham Keep and find Old Skarn in the last hall of the Bailey, the Keep's first floor, haggling with his drum. Put him down.

ready: Go back to Hedda, by the well in Thornwick.
done: Old Skarn's drum is quiet. Hedda won't get her four hens back; the Redhand ate them. But nobody else will lose theirs.
